designIntent: Readable subculture-game anchor shotgun. The anchor silhouette is integrated into the shoulder stock; the muzzle keeps one open central bore with four restrained connected prongs. Avoid additional spikes, cables, cages, detached rings, and layered ornaments.

inputPreparation.left: Exact approved source image; no design edit.
inputPreparation.right: Exact pixel mirror of left; no design edit.
inputPreparation.front: Uniformly scaled and transparent-padded only. Prepared object height matches the side-view muzzle housing height.
inputPreparation.back: Uniformly scaled and transparent-padded only. Prepared object height matches the side-view anchor-stock height.

texturePolicy.cyanPolicy: Treat cyan as authored surface color only until a separate exact emission mask is approved. Do not trust automatic emission.

rawGeometryStopConditions: Central muzzle bore is capped, filled, duplicated, or shallower than the Project2 minimum.
Any muzzle prong floats, crosses the bore, or becomes an unrelated detached ring.
Either anchor-stock opening collapses or the anchor silhouette no longer reads in both side views.
Trigger grip or vertical foregrip cannot provide a clean one-hand contact surface.
Stock, receiver, barrel, muzzle, trigger grip, or foregrip are disconnected in 3D.
The output is a folded 2.5D reconstruction or places the complete weapon silhouette on the wrong axis.
